name: copilotprompts-prompt-m365-work-year-wrapped-prompt
title: My Work Year, Wrapped
shortDescription: Create a colorful, witty six-card visual recap of your work year, highlighting accomplishments, recurring themes, and a headline for next year.
longDescription: Use Microsoft 365 Copilot to create a celebratory 2026 Work Wrapped visual from available work context. Six cards cover a breakout accomplishment, recurring side quest, signature work move, biggest plot twist, underrated contribution, and a headline for next year. The prompt asks for evidence-supported observations without invented statistics or claims of unavailable data access.

thumbnails.alt: April Dunnam's colorful 2026 Work Wrapped visual, with six cards about accomplishments, travel, clear explanations, a shipped product, reusable teaching materials, and next year's headline.
